qualityHeight.description: QualityHeight is the selected ladder rung; 0 / omitted means original/source.

chapters.description: Chapters are container chapter atoms on any video file (not limited to film/series).

series.description: Series is set only for paths in a series library with resolvable S/E identity.

skipIntro.description: SkipIntro is set when chapter metadata identifies an opening intro segment (E-23).

userSubtitle.description: UserSubtitle is the current user's uploaded caption when present (TTL 1d).

udn.description: UDN is a stable uuid:… for SSDP (generated on first save when empty).

movie_hash.description: System-owned identity hashes (scan-time; never overwritten; not PATCH-editable).

subtitle.description: Subtitle lists supported subtitle delivery modes (e.g. "external").

info.description: HTTP API for browsing and streaming media files.
info.title: sudoStream API

get.description: Shallow directory listing for the library folder picker. Skips dot-directories.
Returns registered media libraries for ACL management.

post.description: Creates an empty library. Attach folders with POST /roots.
Prunes library roots whose folders are missing on disk. Does not auto-create libraries.

delete.description: Removes the library registry row and grants. Media files are not deleted.

patch.description: Sets display name and/or UI type for a registered library. Name is display-only.

get.description: Admin only. Metadata/poster/subtitle provider settings for film and series libraries. Never mandatory.

patch.description: Admin only. At most one provider per slot (metadata/poster/subtitle); all slots optional.

delete.description: Detaches a folder from the library. Files stay on disk.

post.description: Attaches a media-relative folder to the library. Exclusive across libraries.
Re-probes video metadata for one library folder.

get.description: Schedules and latest runs for libraries.scan and playback.cache.purge.
Returns all libraries with the user's CRUD permissions.

put.description: Replaces all library CRUD grants for a non-admin user.

post.description: Always returns 204 to avoid email enumeration.
Authenticates a user. May return a 2FA challenge instead of tokens.

get.description: Returns the authenticated user profile.

post.description: Reads the httpOnly refresh cookie and returns a new access token.

get.description: Returns immediate children (shallow) for the media root, paginated.
Returns immediate children (shallow) for a path under the media root, paginated.
Film movie cards or series show cards for a typed library (paginated).
Season/special headers with episode counts (episodes loaded separately).
Episodes for one season of a show (full season when limit omitted).

parameters.description: Optional page size (omit for full season; max 100)
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Downloads file content with content-disposition attachment.
Returns whether the current user has favorited a media file

patch.description: Marks or clears favorite for a media file for the current user

get.description: Returns service health and the current application version.
Returns libraries the current user may read, including type metadata.

delete.description: Moves a media path into /media/.trash; directories are always recursive

parameters.description: Ignored for recycle-bin deletes; directories always move as a tree
parameters.name: recursive

get.description: Returns cached original and override metadata for a video path.

patch.description: Updates per-file override metadata or writes embedded file tags via ffmpeg.

get.description: Retrieve HLS master playlist or media segments for video playback

parameters.description: Media file path with optional HLS resource suffix
parameters.name: path

get.description: Retrieve job status, qualities, and tracks. Prefer POST + deviceProfile for FI-8.

parameters.description: Start transcode after direct playback failed
parameters.name: fallback

post.description: Accepts a device profile; returns playMethod (directPlay/remux/transcode) + URLs.

get.description: Serves a locally cached poster from providers.posters. 404 when none cached; use /api/thumbnail.
Serves a locally cached subtitle from providers.subtitles. Query lang is ISO 639-1.
Finds indexed videos in readable libraries by filename and metadata tokens.
Serves original file bytes with Range support for progressive playback. Not a download.
Serves a cached video poster (WebP; maintenance warm only) or resizes an image on the fly.

delete.description: Removes the per-user uploaded subtitle for a media path

get.description: Serves the per-user uploaded WebVTT for a media path when present and not expired

put.description: Accepts VTT or SRT (multipart field "file"); replaces existing upload. TTL 1d.

get.description: Returns whether the current user has marked a media file as watched

patch.description: Marks watched state or saves playback progress for a media file

get.description: Returns Prometheus exposition format metrics.
